description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kotawila, North, Weligama D/S Division, Matara District - Cad. Map No. 820068 (23/0206)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of title determinations for multiple land parcels under the Registration of Title Act.
